specification.objective: Rebuild the time clock composition in the reference workspace language without changing workflows or theme.

requirements.statement: Recompose the time clock hero and daily history into a clear responsive clock, location, actions and contextual history hierarchy.
Preserve employee data, clock, all punch and location actions, errors, loading, timeline pagination, accessibility and light and dark themes.
Persist the exact locked contract in docs/contracts/time-clock-rebuild-v1.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Widget regression checks desktop daily history contains operational location context, and the clock and location sit side by side with actions following them, without exceptions.
Affected widget tests and configured project gates pass; the persisted contract equals the lock byte-for-byte.

invariants.statement: Do not alter API calls, punch transitions, location permissions, records, or theme persistence.

forbidden_states.statement: Controls or content disappear, overflow, or become inaccessible in supported responsive layouts.

inputs.statement: Existing time clock page, widget tests, and user-provided visual reference.

outputs.statement: Responsive time clock composition and regression evidence.

failure_semantics.statement: The time_clock_history_composition regression fails on the baseline geometry and passes on the rebuilt page.
